tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /grub mtha'i sdom tshig bzhugs/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /nang pa sangs rgyas bstan pa ni/ /mdo dang sngags
༄༅/ /grub mtha'i sdom tshig bzhugs/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /nang pa sangs rgyas bstan pa ni/ /mdo dang sngags

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grub mtha'i sdom tshig bzhugs// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /nang pa sangs rgyas bstan pa ni/ /mdo dang sngags kyi grub mthar nges/ /mdo la grub mtha' smra ba bzhi/ /dang po bye brag smra ba'i lugs/ /shes par bya ba'i gzhi lnga ni/ /gzugs sems sems las byung ba dang / /mi ldan 'du byed 'dus ma byas/ /snga ma bzhi ni mi rtag rdzas/ /phyi ma gcig ni rtag rdzas so/ /'dod na dbang po med pa dang / sgra med phra rab rdul rdzas brgyad/ /lus dbang ldan la rdzas dgu ste/ dbang po gzhan ldan rdzas bcu dang / /sgra dang ldan na bcu gcig go /gzugs na dbang po med pa dang / /sgra med phra rab sdul rdzas drug /lus dbang ldan la rdzas bdun te/ /dbang po gzhan rdul rdzas brgyad do/ /gzugs ni dbang po lnga dang don/ /lnga dang rnam rig byed min nyid/ /reg bya bcu gnyis bdag nyid do/ /rnam rig min rnams gsum zhes bya/ /sdom dang sdom pa min dang gzhan/ /de bzhin bsam gtan zag med do/ /phung po dang ni skye mched khams/ /mtshan nyid dbye ba dang bcas so/ /gtso sems yid dang rnam shes rnams/ /don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin/ /rnam par shes pa tshogs drug ste/ /gzung 'dzin dus mnyam thugs phrad 'dzin/ /sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig ni/ /kun 'gro lnga dang yul nges lnga/ /dge las byung ba bcu dang ni/ /nyon mongs che drug mi dge'i gnyis/ /nyon mongs chung bcu ma nges brgyad/ /gti mug med dang lta ba dang / /shes rab min dang brjed ngas dang / /rnam par g.yengs ba dang bcas so/ /sems dang mi ldan 'du byed ni/ /thob dang ma thob skal mnyam dang / /'du shes med snyoms 'jug pa dag /srog dang mtshan nyid rnams dang ni/ /ming gi tshogs la sogs pa yang / /'dus ma byas ni nam mkha' dang / /so sor brtags 'gog brtags min 'gog /bden pa gnyis kyi rnam bzhag ni/ /gang la bcom dang blo yi gzhan/

/bsal na de blo mi 'jug pa/ /bum chu bzhin du kun rdzob du/ /yod de don dam yod gzhan no/ /de ltar shes bya'i gzhi lnga po/ /rdzas grub bden pa'i dngos por 'dod/ /'dus ma byas gsum rtag rdzas dang / /'dus byas thams cad dus gsum gyis/ /bsdus shing dus gsum rdzas grub 'dod/ /de nas lam gyi skye tshul ni/ /ma chags 'phags rigs de dag las/ /gsum ni chog shes bdag nyid do/ /tshul gnas thos dang bsam gtan pas/ /bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /bsgom tshul zhi gnas lhag mthong ngo / /tshogs lam chung 'bring che gsum po/ /rim par dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ /yang dag spong bzhi rdzu 'phrul gyi/ /rkang pa bzhi po bsgom pa'o/ /sbyor lam drod rtser dbang po lnga/ /bzod chos gnyis su stobs lnga bsgom/ /mthong bsgom byang chub yan lag bdun/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad bcas so/ /mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug /bsgom pa'i lam la rnams gnyis te/ /mi slob yan lag bcu ldan no/ /nyan thos brtson myur tshe gsum ste/ /bul ba la ni nges pa med/ /rang rgyal bse ru bskal pa brgya/ /dbang rnon yin no 'bring rtul gnyis/ /tshogs na spyod pa nyid du bzhed/ /sangs rgyas bskal pa grangs med gsum/ /nyan thos la'ang skyes 'phags gnyis/ /snga ma dad dang chos rjes 'brang / /'phags pa zhugs gnas brgyad yin no/ /shes pa gsum dang bcur dbye'o/ /ldan tshul mthong sgom gnyis la bdun/ /dgra bcom pa la bcu ru bshad/ /sangs rgyas yon tan thun min dang / /gzhan dang thun mong gyur pa'o/ /dang po ma 'dres pa bco brgyad/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam phun tshogs so/ /gnyis pa thun mong gyur pa ni/ nyon mongs med dang smon gnas shes/ /yang dag rig bzhi mngon shes pa/ /nyan thos pa dang thun mong ngo / /mngon shes bsam gzugs tshad med dang / /rnam thar zil gnon zad par rnams/ /'jig rten pa dang thun mong ngo / /bye smra'i grub mtha' zhib par ni/

/chos mngon mdzod kyi gzhung las shes/ /bye brag du smra ba'i skabs kyi sdom ste dang po'o/ /mdo sde pa yi grub mtha' ni/ /lung dang rigs pa'i rjes 'brang ngo / /bye smra dgag dang rang lugs brjod/ /bye smras bstan bcos gtsor byed pa/ /mi rigs phyir te sangs rgyas la/ /ma gus phyir dang bstan bcos nyid/ /bka' la brtan pas de med 'gyur/ /bka' ni mtha' drug bdag nyid do/ /rnam par rig byed min gzugs dang / /mi ldan 'du byed 'dus ma byas/ /rdzas su yod na gzhom rung 'gyur/ /rdul phran ma bsags bem srid skyon/ /dus gsum rdzas su yod gyur na/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar 'gyur/ /shes pa rnam med don 'dzin na/ /sngo sogs dbye ba rtogs mi nus/ /rang rig med na dran pa las/ /bdag rig grub par bshad pas gnod/ /rang lugs mdo bzhin 'chad pa la/ /mdo de dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan dang / /tshigs bcad che brjod gleng gzhi dang / /rtogs brjod de lta bu 'byung dang / /skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang / /rmad byung gtan la phab pa'i sde/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis so/ /rnam pa rig byed min gzugs dang / /mi ldan 'du byed 'dus ma byas/ /rdzas su grub par mi 'dod cing / /gzugs sems sems las byung ba gsum/ /'dir yang rdzas grub nyid du 'dod/ /'das dang ma 'ongs rdzas grub min/ /da lta rdzas su grub par 'dod/ /rdul phran rnams ni don dam dang / /des brtsams rags pa kun rdzob ste/ /rdul phran ma reg bar med pas/ /rags pa nyid du 'du shes so/ /shes pa yul gyi rnam bcas 'dod/ /gzung 'dzin snga phyi tha dad cing / /rang 'dzin nyid la rang 'dra ba'i/ /rnam pa gtod byed lkog na mo'o/ /mi ldan 'du byed gzugs sems dang / /sems byung gnas skabs brtags par 'dod/ /'dus byas gzhi ni med pa dang / /myang 'das dngos po med par 'dod/ /lam dang gang zag bye smra dang / /phal cher 'dra zhing byang sems la/

/sa bcu dang ni sangs rgyas la/ /sku gsum la sogs 'dod pa'o/ /de dag ston byed mdo 'chad tshul/ /mdo don smra ba rnams kyis ni/ /dgongs pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang / /tshig don bcas dang mtshams sbyor bcas/ /brgal lan bcas pas bsnyad par bya/ /'di yi grub mtha' zhib par ni/ /mngon pa kun las btus pa dang / /dbyig gnyen mdzod yi rang 'grel dang / /tshad ma rnam 'grel sogs las shes/ /mdo sde pa'i skabs sdom ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i grub mtha' ni/ /phyi rol snang ba yongs med de/ /sems ni sna tshogs rnams su snang / /lus dang longs spyod gnas 'dra ba/ /sems tsam du ni ngas bstan gsungs/ /dbye ba rnam bden rnam brdzun no/ /'di don 'chad la mdo sde pa'i/ /log rtogs dgag dang rang lugs bzhag /dang po theg chen bkar sgrub ni/ /sngar lung ma bstan lhan cig 'byung / /spyod yul ma yin grub pa dang / /yod dang med na yod med dang / /gnyen po dang ni sgra gzhan phyir/ theg chen rgyal ba'i bkar grub po/ /phra rab rdul phran don dam par/ /grub pa rig pa ma yin te/ /drug gi gcig char sbyar sogs kyi/ /rigs pas brtags na phyi don gyi/ /rdul phran snyed pa ma yin zhing / /rdul phran mi sbyor 'dus pa dag /sbyor ro zhe na sbyar rgyu yi/ /rdul phran med phyir de 'dus cing / /bag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems/ /don du snang ba rab tu 'byung / /don du yod min sems nyid de/ /phyi rol don mthong log pa yin/ /gzugs sogs skye mched yod par ni/ /des 'dul ba yi skye bo la/ /dgos pa'i dbang gi gsung pa ste/ /brdzus te 'byung ba'i sems can bzhin/ /rang gis sa bon gang la su/ /rnam rig snang ba gang byung ba/ /de dang de yi skye mched ni/ /rnam pa gnyis su thub pas gsungs/ /mi ldan pa yi 'du byed dag /btags pa tsam 'dod 'dus ma byas/ /med pa kho nar yang mi 'dod/

/rigs rgyu'i gzugs don gzhan med phyir/ /rang rig nyid 'dod gzhan rig med/ /grub pa'i mtha' 'di'i snying po'i don/ /shes bya'i gnas dang de'i mtshan nyid/ /der 'jug de yi rgyu 'bras dang / /de rab dbye dang bslab pa gsum/ /de 'bras spangs dang ye shes mchog /rnam pa brgyad du bzhed pa yin/ /shes bya'i gnas ni kun gzhi ste/ /de nyid yod dang de'i mtshan nyid/ /ldog dus dbang phyug la sogs dang / /mi 'dra ba yi khyad par ro/ /mtshan nyid gzhan dbang kun brtags dang / /yongs su grub pa gsum yin la/ /gzhan gyi dbang gi ngo bo nyid/ /rnam rtog yin te rkyen las skyes/ /rnam par rtog pa gang gang gis/ /dngos po gang gang rnam btags pa/ /de nyid kun tu btags pa yin/ /rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes/ /de bzhin nyid ni yongs grub po/ /nang gi shes bya'i ngo bo ni/ /phyi rol ltar snang gang yin de/ /don yin rnam shes ngo bo'i phyir/ /de skad rnam bden pa rnams bzhed/ /med bzhin snang ba rab rib la/ /skra shad ji bzhin brtags 'dod de/ /mi rtog ye shes rgyu ba la/ /don kun snang ba med pa'i phyir/ /don med khongs du chud par bya/ /de med pas na rnam rig med/ /de skad rnam brdzun pa rnams bzhed/ /rnam bden gzung 'dzin sgong gshags dang / /sna tshogs gnyis med grangs mnyam gsum/ /sangs rgyas pa la gnyis snang gis/ /dri ma yod dang med 'dod pas/ /dri bcas dri med rnam rdzun no/ /gzhan dbang la ni dbye ba gnyis/ /kun btags gnyis dang lngar dbye bya/ /yongs grub gnyis dang bzhi ru dbye/ /de dag dpe dang bcas kyis bstan/ /rnam rig don der 'jug pa la/ /gang zag rgyu dang tshul dus so/ /tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mthar phyin pa'i/ /lam lnga so so'i mtshan nyid dang / /byed las ngo bo dang bcas so/ /tshogs lam chung ngu'i gnas skabs su/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi/ /'bring la yang dag spong ba bzhi/

/chen por rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi bsgom/ /sbyor lam drod rtser dbang po lnga/ /bzod chos gnyis su stobs lnga bsgom/ /mthong lam byang chub yan lag bdun/ /bsgom par 'phags lam yan lag brgyad/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu 'chad pa la/ /dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang / /bsil bar byed dang khro bzod dang / /mchog sbyor pa dang yid 'dzin dang / /don dam shes pa'i phyir bshad do/ /ji ltar nyan thos theg pa la/ /nyan thos sa ni brgyad bshad pa/ /de bzhin theg pa chen po la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu'o/ /'bras bu sa bcu'i dbye ba ni/ /rab tu dga' dang dri ma med/ /'od byed pa dang 'od 'phro can/ /sbyang dka' mngon du gyur pa dang / /ring du song dang mi g.yo ba/ /legs pa'i blo gros chos sprin no/ /de dag phar phyin bcu dang sbyor/ /sa thob pa ni mos pa dang / /spyod pa dag la 'jug pa dang / /rtogs pa'i phyir dang sa rnams ni/ grub pa'i sgo nas rnam pa bzhi/ /bzang dang smon pa'i stobs can dag /sems brten khyad par 'gro ba yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' grangs med gsum/ /kun du rtsom par mdzad ces gsung / /bslab pa gsum ni tshul khrims dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab bo/ /ma dag gzhan dbang mtshan ma dag /'gag pas srid la mi gnas shing / /shes sgrib yongs spang dag pa yis/ /gzhan dbang nyid du gnas gyur pas/ /zhi la mi gnas 'khor 'das gnyis/ /mtshungs shes spangs ba phun tshogs so/ /ye shes phun sum tshogs pa ni/ /sku gsum dang ni yan lag lnga/ /ma 'dres phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de dag rgyas par bshad pa ni/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa gnyis bral ba'i/ /shes pa rang rig dang gsal nyid/ /chos kyi sku ste don dam bzhed/ /nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ /de yi sprul gzhi byas pa yi/ /bzo skye mchog gi sprul sku'o/ /gnas gyur dkar po'i chos kyi gzhi/ /gnyis med rtag pa bsam mi khyab/ /sngar bshad byang phyogs so bdun steng /

/tshad med bzhi dang rnam thar brgyad/ /snyoms 'jug dgu dang zag par bcu/ /zil gnon brgyad dang nyon mongs med/ /smon gnas shes dang rdzu 'phrul gyi/ /mngon shes so sor yang dag par/ /rig bzhi rnam par dag pa bzhi/ /dbang bcu dang ni stobs bcu dang / /mi 'jigs bzhi dang srung med gsum/ /dran pa nyer bzhag gsum dang ni/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga' bag chags brtsam/ /thugs rje che dang sangs rgyas chos/ /ma 'dres bco brgyad mngon byang chub/ /sde tshan nyer gcig dag tu bzhed/ /rnal 'byor spyod gzhung zhib par ni/ /mdo sde rgyan dang rnam 'byed gnyis/ /theg bsdus sogs las shes par bya/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa sems tsam pa'i skabs kyi sdom ste gsum pa'o// ༈ /dbu ma'i grub mtha' 'chad pa la/ /de yang snga ma'i log rtog dgag /rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa'o/ /de la rnal 'byor spyod pa bas/ /yod pas med pa yod ces pa/ /mi 'thad gzhan dbang kun rdzob du/ /yod na kun btags phyir de med/ /don dam yod na yod mthar lhung / /nged 'di gnyis ka'i klan ka med/ /yongs grub spros bral gzhan dbang la/ /yod na dngos sgra nyid dang mtshungs/ /gzhan dbang don dam yod na khyed/ /rnam par rig pa tsam du yang / /gang tshe mi 'dzin de yi tshe/ /zhes 'dod yod na cis mi 'dzin/ /skad cig tsam du bden yod na/ /skyes sogs cha gsum med par 'gyur/ /de 'dod bar du mi gnas skyon/ /yod na rgyu rkyen ltos mi ltos/ /ltos na snga ma'i grub mtha' nyams/ /ma ltos tshe na gnas 'gyur 'gal/ /khyed cag gnas gyur mi 'thad do/ /don dam gnas gyur don dam min/ /kun rdzob ri rwa la'ang mtshungs/ /bden pa gnyis ka min dam snyam/ /rang lugs brjod la shes bya kun/ /kun rdzob du ni yod mnyam dang / /don dam du ni med mnyam du/ /'dod pa thabs dang thabs byung du/ /gyur pa bden gnyis rnam dbye yin/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten grags sde dang / /bye brag smra dang tshul mtshungs dang /

/sgyu ma pa dang mdo sde spyod/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma zhes/ /de dag kun la rang rang gi /dbu mar 'dod kyang dbu ma yis/ /ming can yin gyis dngos ma yin/ /dbu ma chen po'i gzhung lugs ni/ /thal 'gyur rang rgyud gnyis su nges/ /bden pa gnyis kyi 'dod tshul ni/ /kun rdzob bden par yang dag dang / /log pa'i kun rdzob gnyis su 'dod/ /don dam bden pa skye 'gag sogs/ /spros pa kun bral de bzhin nyid/ /bdag med sgrub byed dbu ma yi/ /gtan tshigs chen po lnga bshad pa/ /phyi dang nang na gnas 'di kun/ /yang dag don du rang bzhin med/ /gcig pa nyid dang du ma las/ /bral ba'i phyir na gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ /gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min/ /dngos po gang dang gang la'ang / /skye ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /yod pa skye bar rig min te/ /med pa nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /nyes pa gnyis kar thal 'gyur phyir/ /gnyis ka dag kyang 'byung ba min/ /du mas gcig gi dngos mi byed/ /du mas du ma byed ma yin/ /gcig gis du ma'i dngos mi byed/ /gcig gis gcig byed pa'ang min/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang / /de nyid stong pa nyid du bzhed/ /de ni brten nas gdags pa ste/ /de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /de ltar yod mtha' bkag byas nas/ /bden med mngon zhen med mtha' 'ang bkag /mtshan 'dzin dang bral zhi gnas dang / /lhag mthong lam la rab 'jug bya/ /theg chen dbu sems sa lam la/ /khyad par cher med zla grags kyis/ /'jug pa rtsa 'grel dgongs pa'i don/ /theg chen mthong lam rab dga'i sa/ /yon tan ming 'pho don thob dang / /dpes bstan zil gnon phar phyin lhag /dri med 'od byed 'od 'phro ba/ /sbyang dka' mngon gyur ring du song / /mi g.yo legs pa'i blo gros dang / /chos kyi sprin bcas de dag la/ /yon tan phar phyin lhag sogs so/ /'bras bu rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sa/

/brnyes tshul brnyes bya sku'i rnam bzhag /dus kyi sgo nas bsngags bcas so/ /dbu ma'i grub mtha' zhib par ni/ /klu sgrub gzhung bzang las shes bya/ /spros bral dbu ma'i skabs kyi sdom ste bzhi pa'o// ༈ /zhar byung rdo rje theg pa yi/ /rgyud sde'i rnam bzhag mdo tsam 'chad/ /don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /bya rgyud rang rkang bdag bskyed med/ /bris sku lhar bsgom de'i thugs ka'i/ /sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu bya/ /kun spyod dka' thub gtsang sbrar gnas/ /rje dpon lta bur dngos grub len/ /bya rgyud bdag bskyed yod gyur na/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes 'brang yin/ /chu yi dbang bskur cod pan dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la bris sku dang / /rang nyid gnyis ka lhar bsgom nas/ /grogs po lta bur dngos grub len/ /rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang / /spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /rnal 'byor rgyud ni phyi rol la/ /dmigs pa'i rkyen tsam byas nas kyang / /rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa' la/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs nas/ /ji srid phyag rgya ma bkrol ba/ /de yi bar du sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /phyag rgya bkrol nas sangs rgyas gshegs/ /de nas rang nyid tha mal gyur/ /sngar gyi dbang lnga'i steng du ni/ /phyir mi ldog dang drug tu bzhed/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa la/ /rang nyid dam tshig sems dpar bsgom/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs bstim/ /snang grags chos kun lha ru bsgom/ /dag pa gsum las ma g.yos bzhin/ /dngos grub len par bya ba yin/ /'di la smin byed dbang bzhi dang / /grol byed rim gnyis lam la sogs/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs/ /zab pa dang ni rgya che ba'i/ /rgyud sde dag las rtogs par bya/ /de ltar grub mtha' smra ba bzhi/

/zhar byung rgyud sde'i rnam bzhag bcas/ /sdom tshig rags tsam bstan pa 'di/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /bla chen ngur smrig 'chang ba yis/ /bka' lung cod paṇa spyi bo ru/ /rtsal bzhin rmongs rtul rab 'byams pa/ /byams pa smon lam grags pas so// //sarba maṅga laṃ// //theg chen mthong spang la/ gzung rtog dang / 'dzin rtog gnyis/ /gzung rtog la yang gzhi'i rten can gyi gzung rtog dang / gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung rtog gnyis/ gzhi'i rten can gyi gzung rtog ni/ rang yul dor bya gzung ba la dmigs pa dor bya mngon par zhen pa'i theg chen gyi mthong spang rtogs pa dang don gcig gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung rtog ni/ /rang yul blang bya gzung ba la dmigs nas blang bya mngon par zhen pa'i theg chen gyi mthong spang rtogs pa dang don gcig 'dzin rtog la/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / brtags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ /dang po ni/ theg chen gyi mthong spang nyon sgrib dang rang yul gang zag dang chos gang rung rdzas yod la dmigs nas 'dzin pa po bden par zhen pa'i theg chen gyi mthong spangs rtogs pa dang don gcig gnyis pa ni/ rang yul gang zag dang chos gang rung brtags yod la dmigs nas 'dzin pa po brtags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i theg chen gyi mthong spang rtogs pa don gcig theg chen sgom lam gyi spang bya shes sgrib gtso cher spangs ba yin te slob dpon seng ge bzang pos/ mthong bas spang bya'i nyon mongs rnams/ /thams cad yang dag zad byas nas/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa spong ba'i phyir/ /bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes gsung pa ltar ro// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 byams pa smon lam grags pa/ grub mtha'i sdom tshig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
